descricao_original: The trachealis muscle is smooth muscle that spans the opening between the ends of each cartilage ring. Contraction of the muscle constricts the trachea thereby aiding in coughing by increasing airflow velocity. Its flexibility also facilitates swallowing by allowing the esophagus to expand. Mixed gland frequently accumulate next this muscle. 100x
creditos_identificados: Image source: This image was taken of a slide in the Duke University collection.
